title: Juniper and the Signal
author: Beatrix Vasquez
blurb: Felix Underhill, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
